## Goal

What capability or improvement are you proposing?

## Motivation

Why is it useful for the project?

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest independently testable hardware/software step that would advance the feature.

## Standards impact

If this concerns MPEG-2 syntax, decoding, systems, timestamps, or DVD behavior, identify the relevant H.262 / H.222.0 requirement or note that standards research is still needed.

## Hardware / timing impact

Note expected changes to clock domains, DDR usage, M10Ks, DSPs, timing-critical arithmetic, or CDC behavior.

## Alternatives

Describe any simpler or lower-risk approaches considered.
